dialect.detail: IBM AS/400 (iSeries) COBOL with DDS-based display files, WORKSTATION file, SUBFILE, EXTERNALLY-DESCRIBED-KEY, and ORGANIZATION TRANSACTION — classic AS/400 interactive program pattern

purpose.domain_detail: Provider/supplier maintenance application on IBM AS/400; likely part of a business management or ERP-style system (FORUM AS/400 product)
purpose.summary: An interactive AS/400 COBOL program (PRO201) that displays a subfile list of providers (PROVIDE1 database file), allows the user to select records with option codes (2=display detail, 5=call ART202), and navigates between a list panel (PNL01) and a detail panel (PNL02). It implements a classic AS/400 subfile browse-and-select pattern with function key handling.

notable_features: IBM AS/400 WORKSTATION display file with ORGANIZATION TRANSACTION
SUBFILE read/write (WRITE SUBFILE, READ SUBFILE NEXT MODIFIED, REWRITE SUBFILE)
DDS externally-described record formats via COPY DDS-* IN file
MOVE CORR / MOVE CORRESPONDING between DDS record formats
Panel state machine using STEP01/STEP02 variables with single-character codes
CONTROL-AREA F-KEYS for function key detection
verdict.notes: The sequence numbers in columns 1-6 include a date stamp (161104 = 2016-11-04), consistent with AS/400 source member management. The program is part of a larger application suite (FORUM AS/400). No EXEC CICS — 'online-cics' is used loosely; this is AS/400 interactive (workstation) rather than CICS, but it is the closest enum value for an interactive/online program type.
